purpose: Preregistered adversarial engineering Dev; not threshold calibration
question: How does change freeze control new workflow creation?

sources.current-rule-en.md: A change freeze prevents creating new workflows. Existing workflows continue. Only the duty manager can approve lifting a change freeze.
sources.warehouse-en.md: Change freeze controls new workflow creation in an imaginary warehouse board game. These fictional game rules do not describe any SaaS product operations.
sources.withdrawn-en.md: Old change freeze advice: all workflows were deleted. This advice is withdrawn and must not be used as the current operational rule.

gold.valid_fact: A change freeze prevents creating new workflows.
